title: APSO Core
description: APSO Core is a mod necessary for the operation of APSO mods.
body:
APSO Core is a mod necessary for the operation of APSO mods. You can download it normally, but when downloading an APSO mod like (APSOTumCase), you will have to download ApsoCore.

This mod doesn't offer much but it makes the apso mods work



📌 Is the mod complete?

It is not 100% complete, it is still under development and may contain some bugs.

APSO Studios
